text:
zoe: dropping the new compact-playground mock here. main asks: streaming stop semantics, tiny rewind scrubber UX, token pill micro-animations, and prompt-library keyboard affordances. quick accessibility + copy sanity check pls.

matt: nice direction. one big question: when user presses Stop, do we treat it as "accept partial" by default? previous research showed users expect the text is kept. we should be explicit.

anya: agree. suggestion: primary button label "Stop" and beneath it a faint caption: "Keeps partial output for edit or regenerate". caption visible on hover/tap; reachable to screen readers always.

zoe: that keeps UI compact without verbose CTAs. also planning a long-press on mobile to surface "Discard" option. default click = keep.

frank: microcopy nit: avoid "Discard" if we can use friendlier word "Remove". but not a blocker.

matt: token pill behavior note: currently the number animates during streaming which causes screen reader spam. propose debounce 250ms and announce with aria-live="polite". final states like "generation stopped" should be aria-live="assertive".

anya: also add aria-hidden on the animated interim numbers so we only expose stable counts. show a tiny spinner in the pill while server reconciles final token count. spinner should have aria-hidden=true.

ci-bot: CI: compact-playground flag enabled in staging build 2241007000. visual tests queued.

frank: rewind scrubber idea is neat but needs keyboard + screen reader support. label it: "Rewind generation (10 tokens)" and allow ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to step tokens, Home/End to jump. hitting Enter applies the rewind. ensure SR announces "1 of 3 tokens selected".

zoe: yep. scrubber will show discrete markers for the last 3 token groups. default state 0 selected. hitting rewind shows an inline contextual menu: "Apply rewind" (Enter) and "Cancel" (Esc).

matt: telemetry: unify stop events as `playground.interrupt` with method enum {"stop","discard","rewind"}. sample: ```js
telemetry.track('playground.interrupt', { method: 'stop', visible_tokens: 14, ui_variant: 'compact-scrub-v1' })
```

anya: prompt library keyboard flow: arrow nav through prompts, Enter inserts, Space toggles pin. add visually-hidden label: "Insert prompt: <title>" and ensure role="button" on items. change header copy from "Saved prompts" to "Prompt library" for clarity.

zoe: good call. also adding a tiny "Insert" affordance visible on focus for keyboard. toast on insert: "Prompt inserted: <title> (editable)" with role="status" and 3s timeout.

frank: aesthetic: token pill shadow and subtle scale on increment feels responsive, but ensure animation duration <200ms and reduced-motion respects prefers-reduced-motion.

matt: regen race risk: if user triggers Regenerate while a previous stream is still shutting down we sometimes double-charge in dedicated infra. file INF-9881 and add client-side regen lock + server idempotency key per session.

ci-bot: ticket INF-9881 created by matt.

anya: dev handoff checklist: 
- Stop caption copy + long-press discard option
- Token pill: debounce 250ms, spinner, aria-hidden interim numbers, reduced-motion handling
- Rewind scrubber: keyboard + SR labels + discrete markers
- Prompt library: keyboard nav, pin action, visually-hidden labels, header copy change
- Telemetry: `playground.interrupt` naming and sample payloads
- Toasts role=status, 3s auto-dismiss
- Infra ticket INF-9881 for regen dedupe

zoe: i'll update Figma with the caption and scrubber states and push frames to the handoff board. planning a quick voiceover pass tomorrow. anyone object?

matt: no objections. i'll slot the CSS tokens and animation rules.

anya: I'll run a11y checks on staging once frames are in. thanks everyone :raised_hands:

zoe: thanks team. pinning landing checklist in thread.
